data.name: Mursilah
data.gender_notes: Mursilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Rasala' which means 'to send'. Mursilah is a beautiful name for a girl that signifies tenderness, gentleness, and delicacy. In Islamic tradition, it is often associated with the kindness and compassion of Allah. The name Mursilah carries the meaning “Gentle, Soft, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mursilah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle nature of Allah towards His creation.
data.etymology: Mursilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Soft, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mursilah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

This name reminds us of Allah's infinite mercies and invites us to practice love and forgiveness in our daily lives.
